# v0.1.1 — rescan fix / 重新扫描修复

## Fixes

- **Rescan no longer collapses to the 7-day filter.** The Rescan button passed its click event into the age-mode argument, so every rescan ran with `olderThanHours: 168` no matter which mode was selected. Caches written within the last week then came back as `0 B` and every row looked empty. The button now re-scans with the mode shown on the page, and only `'week'` / `'all'` are accepted as mode values.
  - 点击「重新扫描」时不再误用 7 天过滤。此前按钮把点击事件当成了模式参数，导致无论选哪个模式都按 `168` 小时扫描，于是所有行都显示「无缓存」。
- **The settings page opens in *Everything* mode** so the inventory is visible on first load; *Only a week old* stays a deliberate, conservative choice.
  - 设置页默认打开「全部缓存」模式，首次进入即可看到完整清单；「仅 7 天前的」仍是主动选择的保守模式。

## Improvements

- Scan results now carry `freshBytes` / `freshFiles` per target and in `totals`, so skipped recent caches are quantifiable.
- The settings page labels recently written caches as `近期写入 {size}，保留` / `written recently, kept` instead of “no cache”, and explains why nothing is eligible when the week filter matches nothing.
- The `cache_scan` tool output lists `X kept` per target plus a total line for recently written bytes kept by the age filter.

## Upgrade

```bash
# in DeepSeek Harness
plugin_manager action=remove_bundle   target=dsh-cache-cleaner
plugin_manager action=install_bundle  target=/path/to/dsh-cache-cleaner
```

or toggle the plugin row off/on in **Settings → Plugins**, then refresh the page (the client bundle is served with a new revision).
